    key = tuple(sorted((u,v)))
    und_pair_times[key].append(t)
    neighbors[u].add(v)
    neighbors[v].add(u)

for k in list(und_pair_times.keys()):

from itertools import combinations
for B,C in combinations(nodes_list,2):
    keyBC = tuple(sorted((B,C)))
    timesBC = und_pair_times.get(keyBC, [])
    if not timesBC:
        continue
    common = neighbors[B] & neighbors[C]
    if not common:
        continue
    for A in common:
        if A==B or A==C:
            continue
        keyAB = tuple(sorted((A,B)))
        keyAC = tuple(sorted((A,C)))
        timesAB = und_pair_times.get(keyAB, [])
        timesAC = und_pair_times.get(keyAC, [])
        if not timesAB or not timesAC:
            continue
        # for each t1 < t2 where t2 in window
        for t1 in timesAB:
            for t2 in timesAC:
